description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a highly confidential search for a key leadership role within a recently acquired facility, offering a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.

The ideal candidate will be a proactive and results-driven professional with a strong ability to drive census growth and enhance community presence. This role requires a presentable individual who is prepared to work occasional weekends to meet business needs and engage with the community effectively.

This position offers excellent compensation for the right individual, reflecting the importance of this role to the facility's continued success and growth. If you are a 'hustler' with a passion for healthcare marketing and a proven track record, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare setting.
Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills.
Ability to work occasional weekends as required.
Demonstrated proactive and results-driven approach to marketing and census development.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Pays well for the right person
